design.objective: Add an explicit business-module dimension to platform notifications so users can identify and server-filter configuration-management and future module messages without changing global unread semantics.
users: Approvers identify and filter configuration-management tasks in the global notification drawer.
Applicants distinguish approval-result notifications from different business modules.
Future business modules publish module-aware notifications through platform contracts.

requirements.statement: Notifications must persist and return a stable module code and display name independently from source name, business type and business key.
acceptance: configuration-management workflow notifications contain release and 配置管理
the UI shows 配置管理 · 审批中心
businessType remains release_application
requirements.source: User selected option 1 and confirmed separate module and source semantics on 2026-08-18.
counterexample: all workflow notifications only show 审批中心
the frontend derives the module from actionPath

requirements.statement: New business-owned workflows must explicitly carry module metadata through instance and lifecycle context into system notifications.
acceptance: release submissions provide release and 配置管理
workflow lifecycle notifications preserve module metadata
future modules do not require frontend mappings
requirements.source: User confirmed explicit workflow-context propagation and compatibility design on 2026-08-18.
counterexample: the workflow notification bridge permanently hardcodes every businessType mapping
new workflows silently omit module metadata

requirements.statement: The notification drawer must provide a searchable business-module selector that performs server-side filtering across all and unread views.
acceptance: default is all modules
selecting release resets to page one and returns only release notifications
clearing restores all modules
options only include modules visible to the current user
requirements.source: User explicitly requested module filtering and confirmed the interaction on 2026-08-18.
counterexample: only the currently loaded 20 records are filtered
module options expose another user's modules

requirements.statement: Global and filtered unread counts must remain distinct and internally consistent.
acceptance: the bell always shows the user's global unread count
the unread tab shows the selected module's unread count
mark-read operations refresh both scopes
requirements.source: User confirmed the count rules on 2026-08-18.
counterexample: selecting a module changes the bell badge to a module-only count
filtered unread count is inferred from the current page

requirements.statement: An append-only migration and runtime compatibility path must preserve existing notifications and running workflows.
acceptance: known legacy business types receive the agreed module mapping
unknown legacy rows receive a deterministic fallback
running pre-change workflows can complete and notify
published migrations remain unchanged
requirements.source: User confirmed migration and compatibility rules on 2026-08-18.
counterexample: a running workflow fails because module metadata is absent

requirements.statement: Module queries and options must preserve authenticated tenant and user isolation and define explicit empty and failure behavior.
acceptance: unknown module codes return an empty page
module aggregation starts from the current user's notification rows
module-option failure does not destroy the unfiltered list
requirements.source: Existing notification security contract and user-confirmed server-side filtering.
counterexample: the client submits a user id
the server returns all tenant modules before client filtering

requirements.statement: The shared notification drawer must remain usable on desktop and required mobile viewports with module filtering, long text, loading, empty and failure states.
acceptance: no drawer or page horizontal overflow at 375x812, 390x844, 430x932 and desktop
selector, tabs and notification actions remain reachable
long module names and business keys remain readable
requirements.source: RDDMP frontend and mobile design constraints.
counterexample: the selector clips the unread tab
the drawer requires page-level horizontal scrolling

invariants: platform/system remains the notification and read-state data owner
notification queries remain tenant- and current-user-scoped
notification idempotency remains tenantId plus businessType plus eventId
global mark-all-read retains its existing all-module scope
unrelated rokey worktree changes remain untouched
constraints: public platform notification and workflow contracts change in one requirement
non_goals: external notification channels or WebSocket delivery
notification templates, preferences, attachments, deletion or bulk operations

selected_approach.name: explicit notification module metadata with workflow-context propagation and server-side filtering
selected_approach.reason: It keeps module, source and business-object semantics separate, supports correct pagination and user isolation, and scales to future business modules without frontend mappings.

alternatives.name: frontend businessType mapping
alternatives.rejected_because: it couples the shared UI to every business type and cannot correctly filter server pagination

alternatives.name: actionPath inference
alternatives.rejected_because: routes may be absent or change and do not form a reliable data contract

inside: shared notification drawer display and filtering

components.name: SystemNotificationPublisher
components.responsibility: validate and publish module-aware notifications through the platform public contract

components.name: SystemNotificationService
components.responsibility: persist module metadata and perform user-scoped list, aggregation, count and read operations

components.name: WorkflowBusinessContext
components.responsibility: carry originating business-module metadata through workflow persistence and lifecycle events

components.name: WorkflowSystemNotificationBridge
components.responsibility: translate workflow task and result events into module-aware notifications

components.name: UiNotificationCenter
components.responsibility: render module and source, manage status and module filters, pagination, counts and recoverable states

components.name: V44 candidate migration
components.responsibility: add module metadata and indexes and backfill existing notifications and workflow context

interfaces.name: NotificationPublishCommand
interfaces.contract: requires valid moduleCode and moduleName in addition to existing notification fields

interfaces.name: GET /api/notifications
interfaces.contract: optional moduleCode and unreadOnly filters are applied within the authenticated user's scope

interfaces.name: GET /api/notifications/modules
interfaces.contract: returns only current-user modules with total and unread counts ordered by latest notification

interfaces.name: WorkflowBusinessContext
interfaces.contract: new business-owned flows explicitly provide stable module code and display name

error_handling.condition: missing or invalid module metadata on publish
error_handling.behavior: reject the command without partial notification writes
error_handling.recovery: caller supplies a valid stable module code and display name

error_handling.behavior: return an empty user-scoped page and zero scoped count
error_handling.recovery: clear or select a returned module option

error_handling.behavior: keep the unfiltered notification list usable and show a recoverable selector error

error_handling.condition: legacy workflow context lacks module metadata
error_handling.behavior: use the controlled compatibility resolver and record a warning
error_handling.recovery: new workflow rounds persist explicit metadata

error_handling.condition: read-state write succeeds but count refresh fails
error_handling.behavior: retain the authoritative write and show a refresh error
